candidates.purpose: Typed SEC EDGAR parser for 8-K, Form 4, 13F, S-1, Form D, Form 144, Schedule 13D/G and other filings.
candidates.latencySuitability: MEDIUM-HIGH for filing/event detection; not a tick-data source

candidates.docsTests: Extensive documentation, typed objects, smart caching/rate limiting and README states 1000+ tests.

candidates.lookAheadBiasRisk: LOW if filing acceptedAt/filedAt timestamps are preserved and later amendments are not backfilled into earlier signal states.
candidates.integrationPlan: Prototype a filing-event adapter for 8-K/S-1/Form D/Form 144 and compare catalyst timing + dilution flags against current SEC sweep.
